messages:
Nina (Finance): FYI CuroSys flagged renewal invoice RNL-2026-11 — they were billed platform subscription twice (parent + subsidiary). They say we should only bill the parent company per SOW.

Omar (Account Exec): They onboarded a new subsidiary (CuroSys EU) and we had two contract records — one for parent (CuroSys Inc) and one for the subsidiary. Sales submitted an amendment to consolidate billing to parent, signed 2026-10-12. Renewal engine seems to have picked both active contracts.

Lily (Billing Ops): Invoice extract: ```
Invoice: RNL-2026-11
Customer: CuroSys Inc / CuroSys EU
Lines:
- PLATFORM_SUBSCRIPTION_ANNUAL (CuroSys Inc) $36,000
- PLATFORM_SUBSCRIPTION_ANNUAL (CuroSys EU)  $36,000
- DEDICATED_POOL_ANNUAL (CuroSys Inc)  $96,000
Total: $168,000
```

Lily (Billing Ops): The renewal run matched both contract IDs because the amendment was applied as an "amendment note" instead of replacing the subsidiary contract's billing target. The renewal engine treats each active contract as billable.

Nina (Finance): Customer insists only parent should be billed. We owe them a refund/credit for the duplicate platform line ($36k). This is a large one-off. Need quick remediation + legal check before issuing credit.

Victor (Legal): Confirmed amendment text requires consolidated billing to CuroSys Inc "effective immediately". Legal is fine with a credit and corrected invoice. Document the amendment and attach to the credit memo. Also add language: "No waiver of other terms."

Lily (Billing Ops): Proposed steps: 1) Void RNL-2026-11 and reissue RNL-2026-11A with only parent-level line items (platform once); 2) Issue credit memo CM-2026-211 for $36,000 and apply to the reissued invoice; 3) Run a backfill job to mark the subsidiary contract as billing-muted so future runs skip it. ETA 2 business days.

Omar (Account Exec): I'll notify customer and apologize; copy Sales legal note. Suggest adding a short one-time account credit as good will (we already have the credit) and confirm consolidated billing going forward.

reseller-bot: Created ticket TKT-9021 linking RNL-2026-11, created branch billing/fix/contract-amendment-9021.

Nina (Finance): Approve steps. I'll create the credit memo and route to Victor for sign-off. Lily, include internal memo INTCORR-410 for FP&A since >$25k.

Lily (Billing Ops): Will do. Also scheduling BF-2075 to make amendment application idempotent in the renewal pipeline so this doesn't recur.

Omar (Account Exec): Thanks team. I'll send the customer note once credit memo is ready. Please ping when reissue is sent so I can close the renewal loop.

Nina (Finance): Closing — credit memo drafted and routed to Legal. Will update thread after reissue.
